subject: Opening of EventThem Studios in Medford
overview: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan interviewed Brian McAusland regarding the expansion of his business, EventThem Studios, to Medford. The discussion focused on local ticketing services, community networking for artists, and the studio's upcoming grand opening.

items.title: Local Restaurant Recommendations
items.summary: Brian McAusland highlighted local favorites such as Eddie's, Alfredo's, and Nappy's, noting the latter's unique approach of not having a formal menu.

items.title: EventThem Business Background
items.summary: McAusland shared the history of founding EventThem in the early 2000s to create more equitable booking opportunities for musicians and artists.

items.title: Ticket Union Concierge Services
items.summary: The discussion detailed Ticket Union, a service designed to manage ticket markets locally and reduce fees paid to out-of-state companies.

items.title: Common Roots Networking Group
items.summary: McAusland described Common Roots, a low-stress connection group for local business owners and artists to share resources and referrals.

items.title: Studio Features and Event Philosophy
items.summary: The new Medford location will include a podcast room, a gallery space, and a recording studio, framing every life milestone as a potential event.

items.title: Eventlopedia Resource Hub
items.summary: McAusland announced the development of Eventlopedia, an upcoming online platform providing guides, reviews, and resources for event planning.

items.title: May 6 Grand Opening Announcement
items.summary: An open house scheduled for May 6 will feature singer-songwriters, ticket giveaways, and local vendors at the new Salem Street location.

items.title: Regional Sports and Internship Programs
items.summary: The participants discussed local sports culture and McAusland’s past experience running event-planning internships for university students.
